skills.label: Device fabrication and structural characterization
skills.text: cleanroom nanofabrication, process development, electron-beam lithography (EBL), focused ion beam (FIB), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), atomic force microscopy (AFM), reactive ion etching (RIE), Raman and optical spectroscopy, thin film deposition (PVD, e-beam evaporation, CVD, PECVD), 2D materials, wide bandgap oxides, organic semiconductors, topological insulators, and topological superconductors.

skills.label: Electrical characterization
skills.text: DC/AC semiconductor parameter analysis (SMU, LCR, etc.), optoelectronic characterization tests (photovoltaic cells, optical detectors/sensors), low-noise/precision measurements (lock-in amplifiers, Atto-sense modules, low-temperature LPFs), cryogenic systems, quantum transport, phase-sensitive magnetic/flux measurements.

skills.label: Computation, data analysis, and automation
skills.text: Python, Mathematica, LabVIEW, KLayout (layout/mask design), statistical analysis, instrument automation.

research.lab: CNSE, University at Albany, USA (Prof. Ji Ung Lee’s lab)
research.topic: Topological superconductivity for fault-tolerant quantum computation
items: Electrical transport studies of topological superconductors in collaboration with Stony Brook University and BNL (Prof. Qiang Li and Prof. Genda Gu).
Developed processes for end-to-end fabrication of nanoscale quantum devices.
Upgraded a closed-cycle cryostat, designed and implemented cryogenic low-pass filters (LPFs) for precision electrical measurements, and developed Python scripts for instrument automation.
Demonstrated half-integer flux quantization, intrinsic magnetization of the superconducting condensate, and Aharonov-Bohm oscillations of edge states in mesoscopic Fe(Te,Se) devices.

research.lab: Laboratory for nanotechnology, University of Tehran, Iran (Prof. Abdi’s lab)
research.topic: CMOS-compatible solid-state devices based on 2D materials
items: Investigated charge transport across graphene-silicon 2D/3D Schottky junctions.
Developed a model for the fundamental efficiency of graphene-based solar cells.
Fabricated and characterized infrared detectors based on 2D MoS2 layers.
Developed scalable position-sensitive detectors based on hybrid organic/inorganic PEDOT:PSS/Silicon heterojunctions (APL Editor’s Pick).
Pioneered a scalable method for synthesis of 2D borophene metallic layers using chemical vapor deposition.

research.lab: Department of Physics, University of Tehran (Prof. Abdi’s and Prof. Arzi’s joint group)
items: Fabrication and characterization of nanostructured solar cells based on dye-sensitized solar cells (solar simulator, IV, quantum efficiency, carrier lifetime and diffusion length measurement).
Monte-Carlo simulation of charge transport in disordered wide band-gap semiconductors for photovoltaic and optoelectronic applications.
Computer modeling for PECVD growth of single-standing carbon nanotubes.

research.lab: Nanoelectronic laboratory, Tarbiat Modares University, Iran (Dr. Sara Darbari’s lab)
items: Investigated sound-driven CNT-based tribo-electric nanogenerator in sonic array.
Developed a piezo-phototronic device based on graphene/MoS2 heterostructure.
